notes: ha-adam is rendered a man, so its article is unrepresented under rule 29 and the indefinite article goes to the noun under rule 15; the rectum carries a determiner of its own, so nothing is fronted onto the construct.
The article on nefesh and the agreement article are both unrepresented, the demonstrative pronoun being what the written that renders, exactly as rule 41's ha-maqom ha-hu case.
The closing verbless clause gives is upon to the prepositional predicate under rule 49, discontinuous around the adverb yet.
